claim_text: 161 contrasts (160 library compounds + DFO) are directly estimable across 12 balanced plates; 12 RedMix compounds lack within-plate DMSO controls.
Across 7,871 retained proteins, the 14 frozen aging-associated programs achieve 26% to 90% coverage with maximum pairwise Jaccard overlap <= 0.11.
limitations: Whole-cell HepG2 lysate under-represents secreted cytokines

claim_text: Within-plate DMSO split-half null calibration (DMSO_A vs DMSO_B across 11 plates) yields 0/7,871 significant proteins, 0/14 significant aging programs (all BH q = 0.996), and null CGS_unadj = +0.016 (p = 0.987).
statistical_family: Paired t + CAMERA BH FDR (n=14) & Stouffer Z
limitations: Technical sanity check across 11 plates with 2 DMSOs

claim_text: Under standard regularized correlation-aware CAMERA (rho = 0.01) and global BH FDR (2,254 tests), 504/2,254 pairs across 159/161 contrasts are significant at q < 0.05 (736 at q < 0.10, 1,071 at q < 0.20), compared with 826/2,254 under permutation GSEA and 218/2,254 under unregularized empirical VIF.

Using the 14-pathway Composite Geroprotective Score (CGS), Binimetinib ranks #1 overall (CGS_adj = +3.29, CGS_combined = +3.68, BH q = 0.0028), followed by Cyclothiazide (+2.91, q = 0.0185), Zanubrutinib (+2.40, q = 0.0593), Baicalein (+2.22, q = 0.0836), Almonertinib (+2.20, q = 0.0870), Ferulic acid (+2.13, q = 0.0981), and alpha-Lipoic Acid (+2.01, q = 0.1207).
limitations: Requires primary-cell and functional respirometry/SASP validation

claim_text: The Composite Geroprotective Score separates pro-aging and cytotoxic controls at the opposite tail (BH q <= 0.001), including DFO (-6.15, #161/161), Amiodarone (-5.53, #160/161), 1st-gen EGFR inhibitors (Icotinib -3.93, Lapatinib -2.65, Erlotinib -1.75), and anticholinergic antihistamines (Desloratadine -4.94, Benztropine -4.76, Procyclidine -4.74).
limitations: Observational/in vitro HepG2 alignment with clinical toxicity

claim_text: Binimetinib and Baicalein remain strong specificity outliers for OXPHOS elevation (resid Z = +1.88 and +1.37) and inflammatory suppression (resid Z = -4.18 and -4.28) after regressing out E2F proliferation and global perturbation magnitude, and across zero-centered unit-variance scaled sentinel proteins.
statistical_family: OLS residual Z-score & per-contrast BH FDR
limitations: No direct per-well cell counts; single MEK1/2 inhibitor in screen
